references.text: God's command to Moses to appoint Joshua as leader, which Moses now carries out in verse 22
Moses gives Joshua a public commission before all Israel, a parallel to the appointment before the whole congregation
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him, referring back to this appointment
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him - the same formula of obedience found in Num 27:22
Joshua takes over leadership after Moses, which was prepared through the appointment in Num 27:22
Joshua's appointment takes place before Eleazar the priest, the same person mentioned in the case of Zelophehad's daughters
The apostles laid hands on the seven chosen men, a practice rooted in the appointment of Joshua
Paul reminds Timothy of the gift of grace he received through the laying on of hands, a practice that goes back to Joshua's appointment
